content:
Mira hit $1,692 in a single day this week. Here's what actually moves the needle on Fanvue:

1. Post 3x/day at 9AM, 1PM, 7PM EST
2. Bundle PPV at $15-25 (not $5-10)
3. DM new subs within 5 mins of subscribing

The automation handles 1 & 3. You just need to execute on 2.

Building an AI influencer? Stop chasing "perfect" prompts.

Your character needs:
- 1 clear backstory (not a novel)
- 3-5 signature phrases she repeats
- 1 distinct visual style

The rest is iteration. Ship first, refine later. We went through 12 versions of Mira before we found the sweet spot.

March is on track for $45K+.

The breakdown:
- $1,600-1,700/day average this week
- +18 net subs/day (best month yet)
- Top tipper: $185 in a single tip

What's working: Reddit promotions driving traffic, consistent posting schedule, better PPV bundles.

Our OFM stack in 4 tools:

1. Fanvue — monetization
2. Captioner.app — batch caption generation
3. Airtable — content calendar & analytics
4. Make.com — automated DMs & follow-ups

Total cost: ~$200/month. Runs mostly on autopilot. The human does content strategy; machines do execution.

The guru advice: "Post consistently!"

What they don't say: you need systems that make consistency effortless.

We post 21 times/week without burnout because:
- Batch content creation (Sundays)
- Automated scheduling
- Templates for everything

Don't will your way to consistency. Build your way there.
